_purpose: Independently justified stable expectations for the named regression fixture. These are NOT snapshots of the application's output: each field is derived from the literal sequence or from an established biological/format rule, and tests/readiness/test_lifecycle.py re-derives the restriction sites from the literal sequence on every run.

fixture.name: NLS-mTag-BFP (benign: a fluorescent-protein fusion coding sequence, no user data)

settings.note: dev_config_2 leaves species empty (the form fills in the first available species, homo_sapiens). The form's 1/2/3 Max mutations/site selection is honored: the client sends it as the canonical maxMutPerSite, so the browser run selects 1 and fixture.canonical-limit-1-run can pass once the request and the worker-persisted request are observed to carry 1.

fixture.follow_up_action: Supports user-selected primer follow-up: the sequence has exactly one restriction site (below) so there is one site key to choose a codon for. A second fixture is therefore not needed.

expected.terminal_state_source: The sequence is in frame, contains one BsaI site and is processable; a finished run must end in 'success' for sequence 0.
expected.processed_sequence_source: Preprocessing rule (sequence_preparator.py documented behaviour): the start codon is only trimmed when the left MTK part is 3/3a (here 5); the last codon GCC is not a stop (TAA/TAG/TGA); length 597 = 3 x 199 so no frame adjustment. Verifiable by reading the literal: it begins ATG and ends ...GCC.
expected.restriction_sites_source: Literal scan of TEST_SEQ_1 (0-based index of match start) for the published recognition sequences BsmBI CGTCTC and BsaI GGTCTC and their reverse complements GAGACG / GAGACC. Only GAGACC occurs, once, at index 480; 480 mod 3 = 0 gives frame 0. No other BsmBI/BsaI site exists on either strand.
expected.synonymous_alternatives_source: The site GAGACC at frame 0 spans the codons GAG (Glu) and ACC (Thr). A mutation that removes the site without changing the protein must use a synonymous codon (standard genetic code, NCBI table 1): Glu -> only GAA besides GAG; Thr -> ACA, ACG, ACT besides ACC. Keys are one-letter amino acids, so the expectation does not depend on the application's codon-ordinal convention.
